title: PROMPT-AUDIT: is the eval set's own ranking, the ground truth everything validates against, confounded by prompt configuration? (zero calls)

plain_description.what: Measures how much the prompt setup changes a model's score on the evaluation set. The same model answers the same 3,430 questions under two prompts. It also catalogues which prompt setups the leaderboard entries declare. No judge calls.
plain_description.why: The eval set's ranking is the ground truth everything is validated against, so it must not be an artefact of prompt choices.
plain_description.information: A large prompt effect would make close frontier gaps unreliable. A small one would make them safe. Result: the ground truth is not materially affected by the prompt. The effect is about 1 point (-0.010 ± 0.004), not the 4.6 points an earlier faulty probe claimed. All frontier gaps are safe, with arx vs iask marginal. Whether gemini's 5-shot setup inflates its score cannot be tested here.
